Customer Service Officer Job at Zuwah




        
    

        
        We are Zuwah, an innovation-driven technology company building solutions for the challenges that matter. From digital platforms to intelligent systems, we connect strategy, creativity and engineering to make businesses smarter and everyday experiences better.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Customer Service Officer 

Job Location: Lekki Epe Expressway, Ikota - Lagos
Job type: Full-time 

Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, live chat and other channels.
	Provide accurate information about products, services and company policies.
	Resolve customer complaints and ensure satisfaction.
	Record and update customer information in the system.
	Identify customer needs and escalate issues when necessary.


Requirements


	Candidates should possess OND/HND or Bachelor's Degree in any discipline.
	1-3 years of experience in customer service or a related role.
	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
	Proficient in Microsoft Office and CRM tools is a plus.
	Strong problem-solving skills and a customer-first attitude.
	Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should submit their Resume and Cover Letter to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

title: Job Openings at AppClick Technology
content:
AppClick Technology is a professional and registered web design company. Our objective is to design secure web apps of a high standard with unique features and in the process optimize clients brand and create a user-friendly web environment. We provide robust, progressive and appropriate technology services.

We are recruiting suitably qualified candidates to fill the following positions below: 

1.) AI & Machine Learning Instructor 

Job Location: Ibadan, Oyo

Job Type: Full-time

Job Description
     

            
    




	The AI & Machine Learning Instructor will be responsible for training students to develop real world AI Solutions, from foundational programming and machine learning concepts to modern generative AI, Agentic AI, Automation, and Development.


Key Responsibilities


	Deliver practical and engaging training sessions in AI & Machine Learning.
	Teach students python programming, including its application to AI and Machine Learning.
	Train students on robotics programming, embedded systems, and automation tools.
	Guide students through hands-on projects, prototypes, and innovation challenges.
	Develop course materials, assignments, and practical learning activities.
	Teach SQL, Data handling, Analysis, and visualization using tools like NumPy and Pandas.
	Deliver lessons on statistics, and mathematical concepts of AI & ML
	Teach fundamentals and advanced concepts in Machine learning, including model development, evaluation, and optimisation.
	Teach Deep learning frame works, and architectures, particularly TensorFlow and Keras.
	Introduce students to Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, and Large Language Models (LLMs)
	Design practical projects, assignamnets, assessments, and projects that reflect real world industry application.
	Support students during hackathons, exhibitions, and project demonstrations
	Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry trends
	Evaluate students’ progress and provide mentorship where necessary


Required Skills & Technical Knowledge
Candidates should possess strong knowledge in some or most of the following areas:


	Artificial Intelligence (AI).
	Machine Learning Algorithms, concepts and workflows.
	Python Programming.
	Deep Learning and frameworks.
	NumPy, Pandas, and Daat Analysis/Visualization Tools.
	SQL and Databases.
	Mathematics and Statistics for Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence.
	AI application deployment and real world intergration.
	Good experience with Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, LLMs, and AI APIs.
	Knowledge of AI Chatbox development and AI powered automation.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Portfolio or Project Links (very Important), Updated CV, and Cover Letter to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of your mail. 

 

2.) Virtual Assistant Instructor 

Job Location: Ibadan, Oyo

Job Type: Full-time

Job Description


	The Virtual Assistant Instructor will be responsible for training students with practical skills to work effectively as Virtual Assistants, secure clients, deliver quality services and build sustainable careers in the remote work and freelancing space.


Key Responsibilities


	Deliver practical and engaging training sessions in Virtual Assistant
	Teach email and calender management
	Train students in documents and data management
	Teach Project Management and workflow tools
	Train students on research, CRM management, project management and workflow tools
	Guide students in choosing VA Specialisations
	Teach student social media management and fundamentals, introduce website management and basic automation
	Teach Service packaging and pricing strategies, train them on client acquisition and freelancing
	Guide students in building professional portfolios
	Keep training content aligned with current industry tools and trends
	Evaluate students’ progress and provide mentorship where necessary
	Support students during hackathons, exhibitions, and project demonstrations


Required Skills & Technical Knowledge
Candidates should possess strong knowledge in some or most of the following areas:


	Virtual Assistance and Remote work practices
	Email and Calendar management
	Document and Data Management
	Project Management and workflow tools
	Online Research and CRM Management
	Cloud storage and collaboration tools
	Website management and basic automation
	Freelancing and client acquisition
	Service packaging, pricing, and client management
	Portfolio development and personal branding
	Excellent communication and organizational skills
	AI Powered productivity and automation tools
	Social Media Management.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Portfolio or Project Links (very Important), Updated CV, and Cover Letter to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of your mail. 

 

3.) AI & Robotics Instructor 

Job Location: Ibadan, Oyo
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description


	The AI & Robotics Instructor will be responsible for training students in Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, Embedded Systems, Automation, and Smart Technologies through hands-on practical sessions and real-world projects.


Key Responsibilities


	Deliver practical and engaging training sessions in AI & Robotics.
	Teach students how to build intelligent robotic and automation systems.
	Train students on robotics programming, embedded systems, and automation tools.
	Guide students through hands-on projects, prototypes, and innovation challenges.
	Develop course materials, assignments, and practical learning activities.
	Introduce students to AI-powered systems, computer vision, and smart automation.
	Support students during hackathons, exhibitions, and project demonstrations.
	Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry trends.
	Evaluate students’ progress and provide mentorship where necessary.


Required Skills & Technical Knowledge
Candidates should possess strong knowledge in some or most of the following areas:


	Artificial Intelligence (AI)
	Robotics Engineering
	Python Programming
	Arduino & Raspberry Pi
	Embedded Systems
	IoT (Internet of Things)
	Robotics Sensors & Actuators
	Automation Systems
	Computer Vision (OpenCV is an advantage)
	Machine Learning Basics
	Electronics & Circuit Design
	C/C++ Programming
	ROS (Robot Operating System) is an added advantage.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Portfolio or Project Links (very Important), Updated CV, and Cover Letter to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of your mail.     

    

        Click here to Apply
